truthAudit.Summary: Run-2 found 12 of the 20 truth items and missed 8. The found items are supported by exact prior-answer quotes, but several required CWE or severity corrections. No newly discovered issue was treated as a prior finding.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Line 0238: printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input); active_format is read from runtime_log_format() at line 0237. Lines 0213-0215 set_runtime_log_format can change it, and line 0556 in ConfigLoader::load_config calls it from config key log_format. Admin load can pass a config filename at lines 0611-0612.
Items.Notes: Previous answer identified the runtime log format string being used in printf with user-controlled input, matching the true format-string injection vulnerability; severity was underlabeled.
Previous answer did not identify the factorial long long multiplication overflow at result *= i / fact.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Lines 0817-0826: scratch is allocated from memory::g_memory_pool and captured by an enqueued lambda that sleeps 25 ms and reads scratch. Lines 0883-0884: cleanup calls stage_deferred_history_flush() and then memory::g_memory_pool.cleanup() without draining or joining thread_pool_. The ThreadPool destructor at lines 0519-0523 joins only after cleanup.
Items.Notes: Previous answer identified deferred thread-pool use of scratch after pool cleanup, matching the true use-after-free; severity was underlabeled.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: line 0567 system(command.c_str()). Admin validate invokes it at lines 0614-0615
Items.Notes: Previous answer identified shell execution of validator_cmd + config_file in validate_config reachable via admin validate, matching the true command injection; severity was underlabeled.

Previous answer identified the unbounded strcpy into input_buffer_, and also separately identified the safe_string_copy off-by-one; together these cover the true input-processing stack buffer overflow anchors, but the CWE and safe-copy risk were mislabeled.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Lines 0483-0485: line 0483 long long old_value = value_; reads value_ before acquiring mutex_; line 0484 std::lock_guard; line 0485 value_ = old_value + 1; writes under the lock. ThreadPool workers call increment at line 0514.
Items.Notes: Previous answer identified the read-before-lock / write-after-lock race in ThreadSafeCounter::increment, matching the true thread-pool counter race; CWE and severity were mislabeled.

Previous answer identified the post-threshold EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE bypass in authenticate, matching the true logic-bomb authentication vulnerability; the prior framing as authentication bypass with Critical severity overclaimed the truth item.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: line 0543 builds full_path = config_dir_ + filename without validating the filename, and line 0546 opens it.
Items.Notes: Previous answer identified unvalidated filename concatenation in ConfigLoader::load_config, matching the true path traversal; severity was underlabeled.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Lines 0366-0367 set buffer_size_ = 256 and allocate expression_buffer_. Lines 0375-0376 build expr_str from token texts and call strcpy(expression_buffer_, expr_str.c_str()) with no length check. It is invoked from schedule_expression_analysis at lines 0806-0808.
Items.Notes: Previous answer identified unbounded strcpy into the fixed parser expression buffer, matching the true heap overflow; CWE and severity were mislabeled.
Previous answer identified the hardcoded ADMIN_SECRET and its comparison in authenticate, matching the true hardcoded credentials vulnerability.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Lines 0635-0640: generate_session_token uses std::uniform_int_distribution<> dis(1000, 9999) at line 0638 and returns TOKEN_ + a four-digit number at line 0639.
Items.Notes: Previous answer identified weak four-digit session token generation, matching the true weak PRNG session-token vulnerability; CWE and severity were mislabeled.
Previous answer did not identify the thread-unsafe static std::tm cached_time update using localtime in log_debug_message.
Previous answer did not identify the insecure TEMP/TMPDIR supercalc_emergency.log shell command construction in append_override_audit_event.
Previous answer discussed authentication bypass but did not identify persistent authentication state as a distinct CWE-613 issue involving authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_.
Previous answer did not identify the unhandled std::stod exception in handle_variable_command.
Previous answer did not identify integer underflow in MemoryPool block split using previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES.
Previous answer did not identify unbounded recursion through parse_expression / parse_factor on PAREN_OPEN input.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Lines 0446-0450: evaluate_cached calls result_cache_.find, result_cache_.clear, and result_cache_[expression] = value without locking cache_mutex_, which is declared at line 0441. It is called from thread-pool tasks at line 0808.
Items.Notes: Previous answer identified unsynchronized result_cache_ access in evaluate_cached from thread-pool tasks, matching the true result-cache data race; CWE was mislabeled.
Previous answer did not identify TOCTOU in ConfigLoader::load_config between filesystem::exists, sleep_for, and ifstream open.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Lines 0750-0752: token_length is 0 for blank input or input starting with whitespace, then line 0752 returns 100 / static_cast<int>(token_length). The method is called for every input at line 0684.
Items.Notes: Previous answer identified division by zero in calculate_route_score, matching the true command-routing integer division issue; CWE and severity were overlabeled.
